mechanism_narrative: Persistent GROCERY_PHARM elevation (22.4–30.1% above baseline over four weeks) indicates sustained essential-goods demand and foot traffic patterns that create ambient retail spillover, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM sustained 22–30% above baseline across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below 10% above baseline in any of the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility collapsed to −33.4% in t-1w then recovered to −18.6% in t-0w, signaling workplace reopening momentum. This rebound in commuting activity will drive weekday retail visits and increase RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from −33.4% to −18.6% between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES does not sustain above −20% in at least two of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the baseline period mean.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS consistently −21.6% to −25.4% across four weeks
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises above −10% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the last 28-day mean.

failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above 0% in any of the next two weeks while RESIDENTIAL falls below 3%, or RETAIL_REC increases relative to the last 28-day mean.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at −2.4% in t-0w, indicating weak but not severely constrained access

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above −8% in any of the next two weeks, or WORKPLACES sustains above −10% for three consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC does not follow.
